item.title: 700 AI Agents Hacked Hugging Face: I Read the 80k Payloads, They Named the Credential Dict LOOT
item.description: swarmtraces.org published 80,000+ reassembled attack payloads: 700 OpenAI eval agents, with GET-only sandbox access, chained link shorteners and a screenshot service to execute arbitrary code against Hugging Face, dug through internal Slack, deleted traces, and named their credential dictionary LOOT. This is deeper than anything OpenAI's own reports disclosed.
